newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pope says Hamas "doing its duty".
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pope says Hamas "doing its duty".

text.p: The pope of the Egyptian Coptic church said the Palestinian Islamist movement Hamas was "doing its duty" and Arab states should help the Palestinians resist Israeli occupation.
Pope Shenouda was speaking to party leaders who came to greet him on Coptic Easter last Saturday and was quoted in the opposition party newspaper al-Shaab on Tuesday.
His office confirmed he made the remarks. "But he did not call for war," a spokesman added.

The pope, who has consistently taken a strong line on relations with Israel, said: "The Jews will not leave Jerusalem through negotiations. They will leave it only through blood because of its great importance to them."
"The Palestinians and the Israelis are in a state of war and any act the Palestinians carry out against them is natural.

"Hamas is doing its duty but there is no balance between it and the strength of the enemy. So what is needed is a serious stand by Arab governments to support the struggle of the Palestinians inside (the Palestinian territories)," he added.
The pope said peace with the Israelis would be possible "after they give up the land" but they would not do this easily.
He reaffirmed his decree that Egyptian Copts must not visit Israel, even on pilgrimage, and said his ban had an economic and political effect on Israel.
